items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: So, he takes four or five, I would take four or five, and we'd take -- and that kept up for half -- for the evening

ctx.x: Don Bias. (Laughs.) Don Bias. (unintelligible) And we were on stage playing, Teddy Wilson was on piano. He came in. He happened to be there, but he wasn't with us, but he happened to be there, and he came on the stand and started playing. And Charlie Shavers. Lord, I looked up, and I saw Charlie --
